bullets.title: Senior Data Engineer Level 2
bullets.text: Situation: HealthVerity needed cloud-native AI and lakehouse scale on AWS Databricks. Task: Architect Delta Lake / AI data platforms. Action: Designed cloud-native AI and Delta Lake architectures on AWS Databricks. Result: Boosted query efficiency and processing scale (qualitative per resume; no numeric uplift stated).

bullets.title: Senior Data Engineer Level 2
bullets.text: Situation: FedEx legacy systems required cloud data migration to Azure. Task: Engineer migration with ADF, Azure Functions, and Databricks. Action: Built migration pipelines and used developer AI tools plus automated workflows. Result: Accelerated FedEx legacy migration integration schedules by 30%.
metrics: 30% faster FedEx legacy migration integration schedules

bullets.title: Data Engineer & Data Scientist
bullets.text: Situation: Enterprise content intelligence and reporting needed high-throughput data movement. Task: Design ETL/ELT on Databricks and AWS. Action: Built high-throughput ETL/ELT pipelines for content intelligence and advanced reporting. Result: Supported enterprise analytics workloads (no numeric metric on resume).

bullets.title: Data Engineer & Data Scientist
bullets.text: Situation: Analytical queries needed a structured lakehouse pattern. Task: Construct Medallion Architecture on AWS S3. Action: Built Bronze / Silver / Gold data lakes on S3. Result: Significantly improved analytical query performance (qualitative per resume).

bullets.title: Data Engineer & Data Scientist
bullets.text: Situation: Product needed scalable recommendations and ML orchestration. Task: Architect recommendation engines and ML pipelines. Action: Used SageMaker, Step Functions, Glue, Lambda, and Airflow. Result: Delivered scalable recommendation / ML pipelines (no numeric metric on resume).

bullets.title: Data Engineer & Data Scientist
bullets.text: Situation: Legacy Alteryx workflows limited maintainability and speed. Task: Refactor into modular Python. Action: Replaced Alteryx with modular Python scripts. Result: Enhanced execution speeds, error handling, and pipeline maintainability (qualitative per resume).

bullets.title: Data Engineer & Data Scientist
bullets.text: Situation: Executives needed reliable reporting and teams needed cloud/Databricks fluency. Task: Automate SQL workflows, ship Power BI dashboards, and train teams. Action: Built Snowflake star-schema–backed Power BI dashboards and led technical seminars on cloud ecosystems and Databricks. Result: Executive reporting plus cross-functional upskilling (no numeric metric on resume).

bullets.title: AI & ML Engineer Intern
bullets.text: Situation: Receipts and forms needed structured extraction. Task: Build AI-driven parsing apps. Action: Used Google Document AI to parse and extract structured data from receipts and forms. Result: Structured document extraction for downstream automation (no numeric metric on resume).

bullets.title: AI & ML Engineer Intern
bullets.text: Situation: Repetitive business processes needed automation. Task: Deploy LokiBots RPA tooling. Action: Automated processes via LokiBots Robotic Process Automation tools. Result: Reduced manual repetition (qualitative per resume).

bullets.title: Income Tax Buddy (Gen AI & RAG)
bullets.text: Situation: Users needed guidance on Indian income tax rules and ITR filing. Task: Build an autonomous tax-guidance agent. Action: Applied RAG over income tax rule PDFs to analyze portfolios, calculate liabilities, and give step-by-step ITR filing guidance. Result: End-to-end tax analysis / filing guidance agent (no numeric metric on resume).

bullets.title: Azure AI Pipeline Monitor (MCP Servers)
bullets.text: Situation: Client pipelines across Azure, SQL Server, and Power Apps needed autonomous monitoring. Task: Build VS Code–integrated AI agents. Action: Connected agents via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to Azure Cloud, SQL Server, and Power Apps. Result: Autonomous end-to-end client pipeline monitoring (no numeric metric on resume).

bullets.title: Automated Documentation Agent (GitHub Integration)
bullets.text: Situation: PRDs, ASDs, and technical docs were slow to produce manually. Task: Autonomously generate documentation from GitHub context. Action: Built AI agents with custom Agent skills connected to GitHub. Result: Automated generation of PRDs, ASDs, and related technical documentation (no numeric metric on resume).

bullets.title: Sentinel (AI Trading System)
bullets.text: Situation: Needed a quantitative swing-trading platform with agent support. Task: Build Sentinel end to end. Action: Implemented with AI agents, Python, uv, Pydantic, Streamlit, Plotly, and SQLAlchemy. Result: Working quantitative swing trading platform (no numeric metric on resume).
